title: Oozing Brass Greek Rice Curry
description: A cultured, fluffy one‑pot rice curry combining Thai green curry paste with a Greek-inspired soffritto, served in a Korean‑brass bowl.
instructions: Rinse the rice under cold water until the water runs clear.
Heat the olive oil in a Korean‑brass bowl over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and sauté until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Stir in the minced garlic and grated ginger, cooking for 30 seconds.
Add the Thai green curry paste and cook while stirring until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Incorporate the diced carrot and zucchini, sautéing for another 3 minutes.
Add the uncooked rice, stirring to coat it in the aromatics.
Pour in the vegetable broth, bring to a boil, then reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 18 minutes.
Stir in the tofu cubes, fresh spinach, oregano, lemon juice, salt, and pepper, and cover to steam until the rice is tender, about 5 minutes.
Remove the bowl from heat, let it rest for 5 minutes, then fluff the rice with a fork before serving.
